description.value: Choice's Market on Cambie is part of a Metro Vancouver-based natural and organic grocery chain known for stocking local and sustainably sourced products. The Cambie location offers a full suite of departments including bulk, deli, produce, wellness, and a bakery, making it a well-rounded stop for a touring cyclist restocking supplies. The store's emphasis on local producers and natural foods sets it apart from conventional supermarkets in the area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Choices Markets supermarket at the Cambie location, listed among their chain of stores with departments including Bakery, Bulk, Deli, Floral, Grocery, Meat and Seafood, Nutrition, Produce, and Wellness — clearly a full-service grocery store. The OSM shop=supermarket tag and website content together confirm Basic groceries as true; the Deli department is noted but no explicit mention of hot prepared food is made. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so all such fields remain null.
concerns: Website content is mostly site navigation and a careers page — no store-specific detail page was returned, so cycling amenities and contact details (phone, address) could not be verified against the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A full-service natural and organic supermarket on Cambie Street with a broad range of departments; a clear and useful stop for touring cyclists resupplying in Vancouver.
